title: Datacomm Services
description: dscdatacomm.com zoominfo.com/c/datacomm-services-corp/347799114 Datacomm Services Corporation (DSC) (operating since 1988, Memphis, Tennessee) is a low-voltage systems contractor serving the Memphis/Mid-South region (TN, MS, AR) for nearly 40 years. It designs and installs structured cabling (Cat 5e–Cat 6A and fiber optics), outside-plant networks, access control, CCTV, intrusion alarms and paging/AV systems — acting as a single point of contact for all low-voltage building systems. Led by President Allen Hendry and EVP/CEO Chuck Jennings, it runs a lean ~22-person team with two certified RCDD designers on staff and revenue around $10 million/year. Clients range from small service tickets to $1M+ projects — offices, industrial sites and especially school systems and government buyers (it holds TIPS purchasing contracts through 2028). It carries an A+ BBB rating and clean legal record, with strong reviews for workmanship and service. Main limits: purely regional footprint and dependence
